content.text: give me 3 random agents , then tell me how many users in the app, then finally give me the mail of the admin

context_diary: I learned that account_lookup with type filters (AGENT, USER, ADMIN) retrieves specific account types, and generate_aggregation_report with metric "count" provides user statistics. The system returns structured JSON with status, count, total_matches, and data fields. For random sampling, I can use limit parameters. The hierarchy shows agents have numeric IDs and localized emails, while admins use simpler localhost addresses. I should remember the exact function names from manuals rather than guessing - generate_aggregation_report not get_report.
